findings.evidence: Lines 154–156 set `desired = WORKER_LABEL` solely from the current label and `target == "awaiting-review"`; no timestamp or worker activity is consulted, so repeated reconciles reproduce the stale label.
findings.fix: Give the overlay an independently verifiable lease/active-review signal and preserve it only while that signal is live, or make the worker reliably clear it and remove the claim that ordinary reconciliation repairs crashes.
findings.issue: `reconcile` always preserves `review-in-progress` whenever the derived state remains `awaiting-review`; after a worker crash, every later reconcile in that state preserves the false “actively reviewing” label indefinitely, contradicting the claimed self-healing behavior.

summary: The worker overlay can remain permanently stale, so the label does not faithfully represent active review and reconciliation is not self-healing.
